title: Concerning the worn and torn apart Garments, or the tattered Clothes, or the Elements, the Cross, and the rest too.

Concerning the garments of pearl-ornament
[72] and the cluster-pieces, or the robes of [72]
Rhōph-work, or the elements of the C-
ross and the rest.
Once again, while the Apostle was seated in the gathering of his
disciples, he said to {10} disciples: What is the {11}aying
{12} written in the {13}, declaring the name of the great gar-
ments? Then, what are these great garments? Or this which
{14} you read at the time, namely 'of Jesus' — what are those of Jesus
{15} there? Or the pearl-ornaments and the cluster-pieces? Or what are
the icons and the robes of Rhōph-work? Or what is the name 'cross,
element of light'? Or, likewise, what is the cru-
cifix of the light? Or why do they name others 'the coun-
sel of life'? Or what is the soul that is afflicted, being slain,
being strangled, dead within the Enemy? What are all these names
— for behold, they are written, they are sealed according to a remembrance
of multitudes of scriptures. Now therefore I question you,
that you may say to me: what are they, or how have they been altered
in all these names, having stood fast in altered like-
nesses? Having received all these (words), his disciples said to him:
You, our Father, are the root {16} all wisdoms; {17}
herefore we entreat you that you may make {18}
(it) known to us forth concerning all these. You shall {19}
since you are the spring of {20}.
⟨p.177⟩
Then the apostle said to them: 'What is fitting for {0}
{1} is to know in this manner: that the garments to which they have given names {2}
as ‘great garments’ — they are the five noeric ones who have been {3}
forth: the body of the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect
Man — those whom they have chosen in the {4} of the Ambassador, {5}
to whom they have themselves given the name ‘Jesus, Jesus’ — that is the Power that
shines light, that has been swallowed, producing fruit, fashioned in {6}
of the cosmos, in the archons that are of the upper place, those who
exist in all the firmaments. The Splendid One, again, is that
which blazes, that is manifested forth in the stars of the likeness, with the powers
{7} the Aromos. They themselves, again — these Jesuses are those who are fashioned in
the {8} {9}lands which are below the head of the Omopho-

{12} to them ‘Jesuses,’ since {13} ⲟⲩⲁⲍ {14}

ap that resemble them, is the Living Power that fashions
her, reaping her, cutting her, swallowing her,
grasping her in the five worlds of the flesh — the
pluckers, gathering place by place.
{16} we have ourselves named ‘icons’ and ‘great
tunics of work,’ {17} are the three great garments,
that of the wind, that of the fire, and that of the water — those upon which the Living Spirit
is mounted, upon his body — having established within them the works
in the worlds, and within them again poured forth the places of
ferrying, having driven them forth, having scattered them before the Omopho-
{18}ros in the foundation of all the works.
The {19}, again, that we have called by this name, is the
{20} that stands in everything that is below, coming upward
{21} the depths of all the lands, gathering inward, casting
{22} upon all the {23}.

{4}Hearing — that which fills all the powers, which they have brought to them

the power of the fruits of every kind and the seeds, which they
{10}crush, and break them, and pound them, and
give nourishment to the worlds of the flesh. And the manner also in which they dry{11}
up (it) and the herbage which she crushes by tearing it forth — {12}
uit also it is, hers, of the entire soul that is afflicted, that is slain un-
to this end. Her other entire kind also — they slay her in it,
{13} ... {14}
For all the names ... {15}
...{16}their {17}is one from the beginning, while she{18}{19}
causes (it) to shine forth. But they were divided into all the kinds
in the first contest. They stood firm in all{20} these likenesses
which are altered, and these names which are many. Indeed therefore
if they shall break apart all these {21}, and strip
naked of all the figures, {22}separate forth all these
names — they shall be gathered inward {23}become one likeness,
one name, unchanging, unmoving, forever, in the
region of their first substance, from which they were sent forth
against the Enemy.
